text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize launch criteria for Dedicated reserved pools + burst windows. Customers asking for guaranteed bursts, but we also need predictable unit economics. Thoughts?

dan (eng): agree we need both. Impl options: soft quotas with rate-smoothing, and a short-lived burst token bucket for overage. Hard caps for safety.

maya (PM): Proposal: 3 launch constraints: 1) soft quota (default) + overage billing, 2) configurable burst window (5-60m) with capped QPS, 3) hard safety cap that can’t be exceeded. If all met — GA.

sophia (solutions): For customers we demo, they want an API flag and Console toggle for burst windows. Also need visibility: per-tenant burst usage and alerts.

dan (eng): Implementation notes: major pieces: quota evaluator, burst scheduler, billing hooks, circuit-breaker for hard cap. Complexity: burst scheduler + autoscale interplay is tricky — especially when Dedicated autoscale is enabled.

lee (sales): FYI: Large customer (FinA) is pushing for guaranteed 10m bursts at 3x baseline for month-1. They’ll commit to 12mo if we can guarantee. We should map SLA tiers -> price.

anna (customer-success): Operational questions from customers: how do they monitor burst consumption? Can we emit Prom metrics and per-tenant logs? They also want webhooks for threshold alerts.

maya (PM): OK actionables: 1) decide soft vs hard default behavior, 2) define burst config API + console UX, 3) billing model for overages vs reserved credits, 4) rollout plan and GA metrics.

dan (eng): My recommendation: default = soft quota (throttled) + optional burst tokens (purchased or reserved) that temporarily raise the soft quota. Hard cap only for emergency and by request. Autoscaler should not react to burst tokens (we treat them as temporary credit) — else it oscillates.

sophia (solutions): UX sketch: Console -> Pool settings -> "Burst window" slider (5m/15m/30m/60m), "Burst mode" = soft|hard, "Burst budget" = tokens or % of monthly commit. API: POST /pools/:id/burst {window_seconds, mode, budget_units}.

maya (PM): We need launch criteria measurable: adoption (>=3 customers using burst), stability (no hard cap triggers in 14-day canary), cost delta <15% for customers using burst vs baseline, and billing accuracy (under/overcharge <0.5%).

lee (sales): I'll prioritize FinA intro to early access if we can support 10m/3x. They also want SLA language for burst availability. We should scope that carefully (not full GA SLA).

anna (customer-success): Add support ticket template and runbook: how to revert a tenant from burst to normal, and how to escalate if hard cap hit.

quota-bot: new quota policy draft uploaded -> /internal/policies/dedicated/burst-policy-v1.yaml

dan (eng): quick example of internal config (WIP):
```yaml
pool_id: redwood-prod-pool-a
burst:
  enabled: true
  window_seconds: 900 # 15m
  mode: soft
  budget_units: 500000 # token units (approx tokens)
hard_cap: 2000000
```

maya (PM): Nice. Questions for PM team: pricing model options are (A) burst tokens included in reserved commit, (B) separate burst credits purchased monthly, (C) pay-as-you-go overage. Which do we want to offer at GA?

lee (sales): Offer A for enterprise deals (negotiated), B for mid-market upsell, C as fallback for self-serve.

dan (eng): Timeline impact: implementing quota evaluator + billing hooks = 3 sprints. Burst scheduler + console + API = 2 more sprints. Canary rollout w/ metrics = 1 sprint. So ~6-8 weeks with one focused squad.

maya (PM): Risk list: 1) autoscale oscillation if burst counted as demand, 2) billing reconciliation gaps, 3) UX confusion between soft/hard modes. Mitigations: treat burst as credit, run heavy sim tests, add clear console copy.

sophia (solutions): For EAs include a checkbox "Allow burst during business hours only" — FinA asked for time-bound bursts.

maya (PM): Decision for this thread: ship v1 as: soft quotas + optional burst tokens + hard cap by request. Expose API + Console controls, billing mode C GA (pay-as-you-go), add A/B later. Roadmap: EA (4 weeks), Canary w/ 3 customers (6 weeks), GA (12 weeks).

dan (eng): I'll spin up tech design doc and link it to the ticket. Need owners: Dan -> implementation, Sophia -> console + API spec, Lee -> EAs, Anna -> runbooks.

maya (PM): Thanks. I'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket and schedule a 30m cross-functional kickoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:

lee (sales): Thanks all — will message FinA and loop them into EA.

anna (customer-success): Adding runbook checklist now.

quota-bot: policy draft updated -> /internal/policies/dedicated/burst-policy-v1.yaml (revision 2)

maya (PM): End of thread — will post the kickoff notes after meeting.
